custom_preconds:
Feature deployed to the custom-roles enforcement env (sv5319/stage).
A seeded Customer exists (fixture-state baseCustomerId) with its Notes tab reachable.
A Customer note authored by the ADMIN user exists on that customer (seeded via POST /api/note/create as admin).
Two custom roles are provisioned via the enforcement harness: (A) Customers View + Work Orders View, NO Work Orders Delete; (B) same as A plus Work Orders Delete. Each has a dedicated confirmed user.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the role-A user (Customers View + WO View, no WO Delete) and open the seeded customer's Notes tab
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Notes tab renders and the admin-authored note card is visible

custom_steps_separated.content: Locate the admin-authored note card and check its actions kebab
custom_steps_separated.expected: button_note_actions is ABSENT on another user's note (no Edit/Delete/Attach options)

custom_steps_separated.content: As the role-A user, create an own note on the same customer, then check that note's card
custom_steps_separated.expected: button_note_actions IS present on the user's own note (positive control)

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the role-B user (adds Work Orders Delete) and open the same admin-authored note card
custom_steps_separated.expected: button_note_actions is present and menu_item_delete_note is reachable

title: Notes - modify actions on another user's note hidden without Work Order Delete (non-WO note types)
